title: Dishti Bomma
overview: Dishti Bomma is a horror thriller built around the idea that no one can escape the consequences of their actions. As dark secrets and past misdeeds come back to haunt those responsible, the story unfolds as a chilling tale of guilt, retribution, and the inevitability of justice.

songs.title: Bomma Bomma (From "Sri Sri") (Telugu)
songs.singers: G.V. Prakash Kumar, Kapil Kapilan, Anantha Sriram
